issuer: the Inland Revenue Division, where the driver's licence fees are paid on the Certificate of Competence from the driving test
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Vehicles and Road Traffic Act (Act 17 of 1993, Chap. 46:50 of the revised laws, its pages authorised by the Law Revision Office 1/1995, on the Government of Dominica's own laws site), s. 32: no one under 18 is qualified to obtain a driving licence to drive any class of motor vehicle other than a motor cycle (17 for a motor cycle), so the full Class B licence is held from 18. The Inland Revenue Division's own page (Tax Laws, Licenses, Driver's License): the motor vehicle learner's licence from 18, valid three months, then the road test, whose Certificate of Competence is taken to the Inland Revenue Division to pay the driver's licence fees; Class B (cars, jeeps, vans and trucks under one ton, and motorcycles) $80.00 a year (EC dollars), less 10% if three years are paid at once (not held), so the fee is held by the year and the term as one year, as the Division sells it. The Act's 1995 text (s. 46) has a licence expire on the third anniversary of the holder's birthday after issue and its schedule a private driver's licence at $100.00 and a learner's at $75.00: the Division's current fees ($60.00 for the learner's) show the schedule amended since, and the amendment wasn't read, so the Act's term and fee aren't held. Learner's fee $60.00 and road test $150.00, not held; Class A $40.00 and Class C (from 21) $100.00 a year, not held.

sources.title: Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Chap. 46:50 (Laws of Dominica, Government of Dominica)
sources.said: VEHICLES AND ROAD TRAFFIC ... No person under the age of seventeen years shall be qualified to ... obtain a driving licence to drive a motor cycle and no person under the ... age of eighteen years shall be qualified to obtain a driving licence to drive any other class of motor vehicle. ... A driving licence shall, unless previously suspended, cancelled ... expire on the third anniversary of the holder's birthday following the date of issue or renewal. ... Private driver's licence 100.00

sources.title: Inland Revenue Division (Dominica), Driver's License
sources.said: An applicant should be at least eighteen (18) years to apply for a motor vehicle learner's license ... A fee of $60.00 is payable for the learner's license which is valid for three months from the date of issue. ... Prior to the expiration of the learner's license the applicants should make an appointment to undergo the driving test. ... On successful completion of the driving test, the applicant is issued a Certificate of Competence, which should be taken to the Inland Revenue Division for payment of the appropriate Driver's license fees. ... Class B Persons who are issued this license are able to drive private vehicle such as cars, jeeps, vans and trucks, which weigh less than one ton. ... The annual license fee is $80.00 ; however, if fees are paid for three (3) years a 10% discount is given to the individual.
